Render the inventory report

Source: R/report.R
render_report.Rd

Renders the package's Quarto template against a results store: headline counts, the table inventory ranked by size and freshness, type and semantic-type mixes, null and uniqueness distributions, candidate duplicate columns and the full column profile as a searchable table.

Usage

render_report(
  store,
  output_file = "db_inventory_report.html",
  engine = c("auto", "quarto", "rmarkdown"),
  organisation = NULL,
  title = "Database inventory and column profile",
  quiet = TRUE
)

Arguments

store

Path to a store written by inventory_run() or db_profile().

output_file

Path of the HTML file to write.

engine

"auto", "quarto" or "rmarkdown".

organisation

Name of the trust or organisation the database belongs to, used as a prefix to the title: "Fake NHS Trust: Database inventory and column profile". If NULL, the organisation recorded by the last inventory_run() into this store is used, if any.

title

Report title, after the organisation prefix.

quiet

Suppress rendering output?

Value

The path of the rendered file, invisibly.

Details

Uses the Quarto CLI if it is on the path (via the quarto package or system2()); otherwise falls back to rmarkdown::render(), which renders the same template through knitr and pandoc. Interactive tables need the DT package; plain tables are used without it.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
out <- inventory_run(fakehospdata::fh_connect("sample"), store = "fakehosp_inventory.sqlite", organisation = "Fake NHS Trust")
render_report("fakehosp_inventory.sqlite", "fakehosp_inventory.html")   # titled "Fake NHS Trust: ..."
} # }
